subtitle: Your personal shopping curator
promotionalText: Your own team of AI scouts hunts drops, restocks and deals across the web, learns your taste, and texts you when they find something you'll love.
reviewNotes: Sign in: tap 'Continue with email', then 'Sign in', and use the demo account below. The account has three scouts with real finds. Baget Pro is an auto-renewing subscription (monthly or yearly) on the Pro screen, reachable from Settings > Go Pro.
whatsNew:
What's new in 1.2
• A fresh new look for Baget in the App Store.
• Small fixes and improvements to keep your scouts hunting smoothly.
